reviews.title: Quality Headset
reviews.comment: My son got this headset, he’s a gamer.  He just built his own PC and loves Redragon, so he had to have this. All the other headsets he’s tried had some issues, but these are are great quality. The audio is clear, the mic is “fire”, and they are comfortable, as he has the infamous headset hair..lol. I love the fact that he can transition from wired to wireless. The price point is great as well.
reviews.author: Amber B.

reviews.title: Work well, will buy again.
reviews.comment: Very pleasantly surprised so far. I have mostly used Razer products for the last several years and have become increasingly frustrated with the problems they all seem to have. These headphones are lovely. Very good sound and long battery. I am switching to all Redragon products for my gaming needs.
reviews.author: Dustin

reviews.title: Only downside is the distortion, mic out.
reviews.comment: Minus only one star because it may just be an issue on our end concerning interference. Bought these to replace an old headset that wouldn't keep a charge any more. The lightweight of it was welcomed but for some reason the antenna in the headset was being interfered with simply by turning the head. This was the only thing wrong with it. The boom mic is awesome compared to my headset that is without one. It is preferred that the ear pieces are without fabric on the inside but there's not really a downside to that. The sound is VERY clear in and out. With the base boosted, it sound amazing. The design is awesome, the color is awesome, the durability is amazing, the simple buttons on the side are awesome so functionality is A+. Like I said, the only iffy thing is the wireless connectivity, interference or otherwise. The mic out makes the voice distorted. Tested with Discord. It's quite entertaining, though.
reviews.author: Jacquelynn M

reviews.title: PC GAMERS! Horrible quality + uncomfortable af
reviews.comment: Horrible quality, wearing this on my head makes me want to rip my scalp off. Audio quality sounds terrible (compared to my previous cheap turtle beach headphones that sadly broke and are discontinued). I use Redragons keyboards and they’re much better but I should not have stuck to them for headphones.
reviews.author: Krystieanna Westlove

reviews.title: One of my best purchases
reviews.comment: Five stars. I’ve used this product every day for hours on end and it has, without fail, served me very well. The audio quality is good in Bluetooth mode, and even better in wired mode. The battery life is long enough that with daily use, you should only need to plug it in when you’re done. The mic quality is satisfactory, and improves in wired mode. They are very light and comfortable on  my head. I hardly notice I’m wearing them most times. So far I’ve only used it for my Windows PC, but it works very well.
